model_name: ME-STGCN-TA corrected torso angle, final all subjects
decision_threshold_note: Median inner-selected outer-fold thresholds; final model has no independent test.

feature_definition.relative_xy: hip-centered and divided by per-video torso scale
feature_definition.joint_velocity_xy: difference of normalized joint coordinates divided by duration_seconds / 31; first frame zero
feature_definition.hip_displacement_xy: raw normalized-image hip position minus first-frame hip position, repeated over 33 joints

evaluation_reference.note: Outer-test predictions evaluate fold models, not the final all-subject model.

realtime_warning: Training clips were resampled as complete clips to 32 frames. A fixed realtime window length must be validated before claiming realtime performance.
